title: Who Blew Up the Georgia Guidestones? The Bomber Was Never Found…
description:
On July 6th, 2022, a bomb destroyed the Georgia Guidestones — a mysterious 19-foot granite monument standing since 1980, weighing over 237,000 pounds. Funded by a man calling himself 'R.C. Christian,' whose real identity has never been confirmed, the monument became a magnet for conspiracy theories, QAnon obsession, and even political campaign promises to tear it down.

Security footage caught a silver sedan fleeing the scene — no plate, no face, no leads. Then, in a stunning twist, county officials demolished the remaining structure just hours later, citing safety concerns — destroying potential evidence before investigators could finish their work.

The GBI opened a case and offered a reward. Years later, no one has been charged, and the founder's true identity remains one of the coldest mysteries in American history. Two unsolved puzzles, layered on top of each other.
